parties.petitioner: The State of West Bengal represented through the Secretary & Ors.

summary: Arbitral award challenge vs limitation period; award received on 30th June 2022; limitation period starts 1st July 2022; three months ends 30th September 2022; pooja vacation begins 1st October; Section 4 Limitation Act (court-closed extension) not applicable as period expired before vacation; proviso 30 days extension expires 30th October; petition filed 31st October held time-barred; Section 5 extension unavailable under precedent; dismissal of Section 34 petition upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's dismissal of Section 34 petition upheld.
